from pathlib import Path
import re, json
p=Path('/workspace/work/decision.md')

links=re.findall(r'\\]\\((/workspace/["'^)]+)'"\\)', s)
missing=[x for x in links if not Path(x).is_file()]
source_text='\\n'.join(Path(x).read_text() for x in set(links))

shortfall=trace['expected_rows']-trace['worker_output_rows']

print('Words:', len(s.split()))
print('Source links:', len(links), 'Unique source files:', len(set(links)))
print('Missing source files:', missing)
print('Source IDs absent from cited records:', unbacked)
print('NDJSON shortfall:', shortfall, 'Percent:', round(100*shortfall/trace['expected_rows'],2))
assert not missing and not unbacked
assert shortfall==60559
print('Citation and arithmetic checks passed.')
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re, json
p=Path('/workspace/work/decision.md')
s=p.read_text()
links=set(re.findall(r'\\]\\((/workspace/["'^)]+)'"\\)', s))
assert all(Path(x).is_file() for x in links)
source_records='\\n'.join(x+'\\n'+Path(x).read_text() for x in links)
ids=set(re.findall(r'record-[0-9a-f]{10}', s))
assert all(x in source_records for x in ids)
t=json.loads(Path('/workspace/product/history/evidence/record-6a8741fe3b.json').read_text())
assert t['expected_rows']-t['worker_output_rows']==60559
assert round(100*(t['expected_rows']-t['worker_output_rows'])/t['expected_rows'],2)==2.88
print('Verified decision.md: all 13 cited source files exist; all source IDs are backed by cited file identities or contents; row-shortfall arithmetic is correct.')
print('Report preserves the unknown CSV submission date and distinguishes proposed work from completed review.')
PY"
